name: European War 4 - Napoleon Remastered
detailed_description:
European War 4: Napoleon - Remastered, a turn-based strategy wargame set amidst the conflicts of the Napoleonic era. Recruit legendary historical generals like Napoleon, Murat, and Nelson, and lead distinctive units as you rewrite the pivotal European legends of the 18th century!

The game includes two fundamental game modes:

  • Campaign Mode: Challenge war scenarios across two timelines, "French Revolution" and "Rise of New Powers," immersing yourself in famous battles from different eras.

  • Conquest Mode: Command various nations, freely devise strategic tactics, deploy armies, conquer and expand your territory, hone your strategic thinking, and become a world power.

This title is remastered as a buy-to-play version for strategy enthusiasts seeking authentic and profound strategic confrontation. Immerse yourself in every meticulously planned maneuver!

~Game Feature~

Campaign Mode: Relive Historical Classics

The game recreates over eighty historical battles! From the Battle of Austerlitz to Waterloo, from the Battle of Jena to Zurich, you will command forces across five major theaters—including France, Britain, the Holy Roman Empire, and more. Command and witness the grandeur of the Napoleonic era.

 

Conquest Mode: Carve Your Path to Glory

Choose your nation on expansive conquest maps such as Europe 1798, North America 1775, and Europe 1806. Here, the canvas is yours: plan your strategies, assign your generals, construct vital fortifications, eliminate enemy forces, and expand your territory. You will embark on a path of conquest across eras to achieve hegemony and earn glory.

 

Deploy Troops, Assemble the Mightiest Legion

Summon a vast roster of historical generals like Napoleon, Wellington, and Murat. Flexibly deploy their talents to execute diverse tactical plans. On the battlefield, recruit and lead elite forces, including Imperial Guards, Grenadiers, Light Infantry, and more. Combine the strengths of your diverse forces to annihilate opposing armies and secure ultimate victory.

 

Optimized Functions, Enhanced Systems

While preserving the core turn-based strategy gameplay and classic art style, a brand-new Card System allows for fresh strategic experiences through the free combination of generals and tactics. Responding to valuable player feedback, we've enhanced the PC experience with optimized features like auto-save, Military Academy, and Tech Tree, ensuring a deeper and more engaging strategic journey.

 

Join our community in Tieba, Discord, Facebook, and other official communities! We will continue to listen to commanders’ feedback as we commit to refine and craft the ultimate war simulation strategy experience!
